claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.note: The DS01 publication page says you can apply to strike off a company online.

claims.claim: A company that has traded in the last 3 months cannot use this service.
claims.quote: has not traded or sold off any stock in the last 3 months
claims.note: The 3-month trading bar applies only to striking off; the text says such a company can close by voluntary liquidation instead, so it is not an exclusion from closing a company altogether.
